She is a receiver only through a `[Statedef +1]` of her root's (run after the state with no gate, so inside a giver's custom state too) whose ChangeAnims, gated on `IsHelper(<id>)`, send his numbers to her art. Read: **the summon**, a Helper of that id in the root's negative states that one command of the root's alone spawns (`Command = "summontagA"` beside `!NumHelper(id)`; the two that want power and a variable are not the gallery's to make); **her states**, from its stateno by her own ChangeStates, and the **ready** ones, where she stands still (no VelSet, VelAdd or PosAdd along x, no DestroySelf) on an animation with a Clsn2 (her four taunts; she runs in 25 ticks and out in 75, then destroys herself: about 3.5-4.5 s alive); **her immunity per giver**, the NotHitBy of her states (value, so slot 0, `time = 320000`: it holds for her whole life) whose trigger fires against him (her badge check `Enemy,AnimExist(125234)` reads his .air): `,NT,ST,HT` for every giver without the badge, so a throw never catches her and only a grab that hits as an attack pairs with her (DongHwan's 4501, `S,NA`; Brian's 4501 is `S,NT`); **the bridge**, the +1 ChangeAnims in order, each reading the anim the one before it left. **Her verdict in a scene** is every animation his state can play on her (the header, then each ChangeAnim/ChangeAnim2 that can fire for her, her own variables at 0 but those her states write, the last certain one on the first tick replacing the rest) through the bridge: sent to an action that draws none of the number's own sprites, her art, judged by its frames as anyone's (the bridge's blank 1891119 for the left-side position 280120-280124 draws nothing: `vanishes`); unbridged, `root` - the root's own answer, or his fallback on the root's sprites (72001's ChangeAnim2 133338 on Kira's 19230). A step is listed only where she is drawn in her art and never as the root anywhere on its way (its until, what it passes through, and its grab's **intro**: the states the grab's steps pass that none of them shows, DongHwan's 7201 - the walk lists it with the first step alone, but every step of that grab is grabbed fresh at times, so an intro drawn as the root spoils them all): DongHwan's position 3 is out (her bridge blanks it). **His explods on her.** An Explod of his in a state she runs is hers, and its anim (no F prefix) resolves in her ROOT's table too, where no bridge reaches it: whatever it draws was never drawn for her (DongHwan's intro 7201 explods 43434 = Kira's own close-up 19230, a big Kira lying beside Chichi through the whole intro; 6216's and 6220's 14250, a second body, which her bridge's own RemoveExplod already takes off during the cowgirl). Every such explod in the states her listed steps pass, whose action draws a sprite of the root's, is listed by id (`receiver.helper.hideExplods`: DongHwan x Chichi 4343, 22260, 23260) and the hook removes it on her after the state runs (below), so it is never drawn; one the hook cannot name (no id, or an id her own Explods use) makes its state `root`. A variable of his that she reads of him to pick an alternative of the root's (`enemyNear,var(32) >= 5`: his climax count picks Kira's broken press 1180207-1180211, unbridged) is held at 0 in the pair's setup, where his files read it for art only (his ChangeAnims, Explods, sounds) - past five climaxes in one grab, position 2 would draw a double-size Kira. Where his own setup already holds that variable at that value (DongHwan's var(32) is also his finish counter), the entry gives both reasons. His own grabs only, never a summon or a companion (their helpers walk to her; she leaves in seconds); every step `edgeOnly`. **A random branch of his that draws her as the root, shut** (`rootBranchShut`): DongHwan's position-1 climax 6005 draws var(49) = random%100, var(30) = random%50 and var(31) = random%30 on its first tick, then gives her 72002 (Kira's 133339, unbridged) on `var(31) > var(49)` at AnimElem = 1 - the same tick - and 72001 on `var(30) > var(49)` at AnimElem 41/43/47, each with a ChangeState of his on the same test (70002, 70001). A draw tested only on a later tick is HELD by the step's setup at the least value his files write it that keeps the test false for every value of the other side (var(30) = 0, the reset his 6005 makes past 100; the -4 undoes the first tick's draw before element 41). A draw tested on the very tick it is drawn cannot be held - it runs after the -4 - so the step names a RE-ROLL (`reroll: [{ from, at, her }]`): the hook's +1, when his ChangeState on that test has taken him on (70002, previous state 6005), puts him back in the drawing state (6005 runs again that tick and draws again) and her back in the step's state that state gives her (6205), before she runs that frame (he is attacking, so he runs before her, a helper). A step whose every root state is shut this way is listed without them: position 1's climax and auto. The pair loads her root and comes right after the root's own pair: "Chichi (Dr.Kira)", her name and the root's first word (`receiver.helper`: id, summon command, ready states, immunity, her art, her own states' actions (`own`: her run in, taunts and run out, for the headless watch), the explods to remove, both scales; `counts.root` her scenes drawn as the root). DongHwan x Chichi has 18 steps: positions 1, 2 and 4 whole (position 1's climax and auto with var(30) held and 72002 re-rolled). In Kira's own pair the same 43434 is Kira's close-up on Kira, as his files mean it, and stays.
- **Her badge, given by the gallery.** Her immunity is her author's grab flag. Each of her states sets NotHitBy `,NT,ST,HT` for 320000 unless her enemy carries the badge, `Enemy,NumExplod(N) && Enemy,AnimExist(N)`: an explod he carries and an action of his (Drunk Samurai, the one giver her author made her for, spawns explod 125234 in his grab state and has a blank action 125234 in his .air). With the badge her taunts set NotHitBy `,HP` for a tick instead, which a throw passes. N is read from her triggers: the same number in both halves, on her enemy. A giver none of whose own grabs she lets through without it is given it where it opens one (`helperGrabs`, `helperPair`); a giver she already lets through keeps his pair as it is (DongHwan: no badge).
  - **How the gallery gives it: her own badge lines, run by the hook.** The pair carries `receiver.helper.badge` { n, sets }: per ready state, the HitBy/NotHitBy her state ends with under the badge where that differs from without it (type, value and time as her file writes them). The hook runs those on her in its own `[StateDef +1]`, after her state has set its own slot 0, while her root's `_gal_badge` (asked by the driver every tick of a helper pair) names the pair's set. Not ignorehitpause, as her own lines. A value the hook cannot write, or a time that is not a whole number, is dropped; the same set in two pairs is one number.
  - **Why not the badge itself.** `AnimExist` on her enemy reads the table of the anim he is playing (`animPN`, his own in his states), and no table in the build has action 125234, so the badge proper needs a file change: a blank action in each giver's shipped .air, or an edit of her root's triggers. The blank action is not neutral in a real fight: her stun VFX helper picks its animation on `Enemy,SelfAnimExist(125234)` alone (15301, the pink ring her author's comment gives an opponent with sex compatibility, over the plain 15300), so against such a giver her stun ring would change while she stayed immune. The hook's lines change no file, act only in the gallery mode, and read her own pair's giver through her root's map, where her own lines read `Enemy`, the first root of the other side (with several pairs, pair 1's giver). The explod is not spawned: without the AnimExist half it opens nothing.
  - **What it opens on the Main roster: every throw, and no pair.** Brian's 4501 (`S,NT`), Minotaur's 1000, 1200, 1590 and 1599 (`S,ST`) and Kur0maru's 15 grabs with a HitDef of their own pass `,HP`. None gets a pair, because every scene of theirs draws her root on its way. Brian's position 2 (6206-6210) is her art through the bridge (his 180210-180214 are DongHwan's numbers) with his finish count var(4) below 4 and his stun fvar(8) off, but his grope stage 6200 (Kira's own 6200/62000), his intro 7201 (43433, Kira's close-up 19230) and 72001 (37239/37240) play Kira's own art on her, unbridged: a double-size Kira at every grab. His position 1 goes back to 6201 with Kira's 180499 after speeds 2 and 3 and the climax (`PrevStateNo = [6203,6205]`). Minotaur plays his 36xxx registry (Kira ships 36616, 36816 and the rest). Kur0maru plays his Kuromaru-template fallbacks on Kira's sprites. A pair for any of them needs her root's bridge to reach those numbers.
  - **Played by hand** (a Brian x Chichi pair written for the test, position 2): his throw catches her, never her root, from where the place stands him, and position 2 shows her art (1891210, 181611, 181614). His grope stage and intro show the double-size Kira. Two more things such a pair would need looked at: at some grabs the scene ended by itself soon after position 2 showed (her on the floor in 5110, him in 105), and his own moves between grabs (205; 235, the end of his throw 850) took her root, 90 behind him. With the hook's badge lines shut (`--no-badge`, her own immunity, as in a real fight), his throw passes through her every time.
- **Setup, held by the hook every frame**: a gauge no input can fill (Minotaur's insertion check `Var(16)+Var(56) < 6000`: every insertion ends in the groin kick at round start), a companion helper that grabs her on its own (Brian's Striker gate var(14); its own steps open it, below), a random position switch (Brian extra's var(18)), meters that make his negative states interrupt any step (Brian's pleasure fvar(39) and stun fvar(7)), each at the value his own files use, and a finish counter at 0 (below). The setup and an action's holds are written TWICE a frame: in the hook's -4, and again in a [StateDef -1] block of the hook - a common file's negative states run after the character's own, so that block comes after his -3, -2 and -1 and right before his state. His own negative states may undo a -4 line every frame: Brian's -2 zeroes fvar(23) whenever his fvar(22) is 0 (out of a scene), so a hold of it stood only from -4 to his -2 and his win state 180 read 0 (played, 2026-10-07). With the -1 block it read the held value; Brian's and Minotaur's first eight scenes play as before (27/27, 24/24).
- **A held meter's firing is a step of its own** (`meterFires`): a meter the setup holds at 0 whose negative states' TargetState puts her in a scene on a value of it (Brian's -2: `fvar(39) = 48` gives her 6600, his orgasm 6400 beside it) is set to that value once by the hook, after the hold, at the end of each position's way: her orgasm per position of his hub, and at the grope stage (there a short wait for the grope's own state comes first, so that in place from anywhere else it grabs again - the meter set in a position would show that position's orgasm under the grope's label). Her art there reads his position of him (`EnemyNear,fvar(23) = k`), so each is judged under it (`timedJudge`: her state's ChangeAnim chain played at each of its own times - `time = 0`, then `time = 100` - as the engine plays it; a state that plays nothing of its own is no answer). A leaf (`leaf`): his way back is x after 150 ticks, which no step's path makes, and no command of the next step acts from his 6400 - so any move out of it grabs again at once (the first action tried in place waited out its whole patience, about 10 s, before). The set lasts one frame (the setup holds the meter at 0 again the next), and made during his climax it never took (position 5 in place from its climax: fvar(39) = 48 set at her 6225 and his 6005, no 6600 within the patience), so no action on its way counts the position's climax as done: moved to from the climax, it waits for the climax to end, as every other position's way does (they wait for the base; position 5's counts every state of the position). The exit press every path starts with never counts it as past the grope stage: at the grope stage that press is his way on into the hub.
- **Stages: a finish counter** (`finishCounters`, the newer H-Mugen "stage" systems, where the sprite work changes after a number of finishes): a variable of his that a VarAdd of a positive number adds to on a finish - in the state his hub climaxes in (DongHwan's 6005: var(32), his climax count; Brian's 6005: var(4), his "baomaru particles"), or in his negative states on a held meter's firing (Brian's -2 on `fvar(39) = 48`) - that his files set to nothing but 0, and that art compares with a number: his own (a ChangeAnim, ChangeAnim2, Explod or Helper in his states) or hers (a ChangeAnim, ChangeAnim2, Explod or ChangeState in a scene of his, reading it of him). It is held at 0 in the pair's setup, so no step's art depends on how many finishes were viewed before it (before, Brian's var(4) grew over the whole match and DongHwan's var(32) over a grab). Each number the art changes at is a LEVEL (Brian 2, 3, 4, 5; DongHwan 5), and each listed step whose art changes at a level gets a copy right after it held there (its own setup, over the pair's 0; `nav.stage` the level's place, the label ", stage k"): his art starting there in the step's own states (DongHwan's position-2 press 42249 at 5; Brian's "siru" helper in his speed cycle at 2), her art (a new picture - frames, not action numbers: Kira's 1805000 draws the same sprite as her 180500 and is none - under the level, her other variables of his at 0 but those the step holds), or a ChangeState there into a scene that shows her (Bao's 16303 into her 65069 at `enemy,var(4) >= 4`, on the copy's way). Such a scene comes after the step's own states and is where the copy ends (`endStates`, on screen too): she never leaves 65069 (her lie-down, drawn half off the screen edge where the climax leaves her), so the runtime grabs again once it has been there 90 frames and plays the step from its start. A receiver's helper gets no stage copies (her bridge does not map the level's art: DongHwan's 1180207 at var(32) = 5 is Kira's body on Chichi).
- **A position his own hub drops** (Brian's position 5): a command VarSet of his position in the state his climax plays (6005's `manguri6-2` at AnimTime 0 sets fvar(23) = 5) for a position no hub command sets (its lines are commented out). Where none of the hub's ChangeAnims animate it and the hub zeroes the position on its animation's end, his files cannot keep it: he arrives from the climax on its last tick, the hub's own `AnimTime = 0` line sets fvar(23) = 0 that very tick, and on the animation's next end it releases her. The step's last action HOLDS it instead (`hold`: kept by the hook from that action on, while the step plays - the position, and the hub's wait `time > fvar(38)` at the least his files draw it, 3, so the hub moves on before any speed's animation ends and never reaches that end), from the first position's base; every action on the way also counts the position's own states as done, so a step of it is reached in place from another. Its base plays no animation of its own (6221), so its steps are its speeds (not speed 1, which hangs), its climax and her orgasm - which comes in its first speed (its command held until her 6223 shows, then the meter): his 6400 keeps the animation he plays when the meter fires, and set at the base, in place from the climax, he was drawn as nothing beside her. His own sprites for it lack some frames (3334,0/4/5): he blinks out on those ticks, as in his game.
- **A gauge gate's failure is a step of its own** (`gateFails`): the scene the gate's own TargetState gives her when it fires (Minotaur's groin kick: her 1695 from 1610-1640, 1895 from 1810-1840, at the insertion's third element) is a step with the gauge at its round-start 0 in the step's setup, over the pair's hold, led by the insertion's own press - once per scene per grab ("insertion fails (press x)"). It ends his scene (1690 goes to 999), so it plays again from a fresh grab.
- **Not a step: Brian's z aftermath.** 6065 plays no animation of its own (her last scene frame for the two ticks of her fall); 15051 plays her common 5110 (the bench's "tailored" rests on 36777/65069, probes in the triggers that lead there, never played); 65069, her own lie-down, comes from 6065 only at match over, which the gallery's round never reaches - it shows only through Bao's position-3 climax at a stage of 4 or more (16303's `enemy,var(4) >= 4`).
- **A scene is her state and the state of his that gives it**: two switches that give her the same state from states of his with none in common are two steps (Minotaur's finger 1260 and vibrator 1271 both give her 1265). Two steps that show her the same states otherwise are one.
- **Per receiver** (the pair bench's verdicts, as the build ships her): a step is listed where a scene of its `until` is tailored, renders or partial; judged on the frames she has (a get-hit sprite beside a scene frame she lacks is get-hit only; the blank group 99999 is no scene art); an `.air` action defined twice is its FIRST definition, as the engine keeps it (`modlib.airFrames`; Yoko's second 36646 is dead), and a negative header is an action of its own, as the engine's Atoi reads it (Kira's `[Begin Action -180501]` after her 1805000 once lent 1805000 its frames, so her position-1 art looked new at stage 3: seven stage copies on Main that showed nothing new); a frameless action his own states route on is her answer (R.Mika's 110810 for Kur0maru's milking). His fallback counts only where its ChangeAnim2 can fire for her: `SelfAnimExist` reads her OWN animation table (not the table of the anim she is playing, as a redirected `AnimExist` does), so sprites without the action are no answer - Kotaro ships 18200 sprites but no action 18200, so Kur0maru's 4821 plays 4831 on the 18300 sprites she lacks and she vanishes. And an action her own HitDefs use as a hit spark (`sparkno = S10050`) is no answer: Kur0maru's 82100 hangs Kotaro's spark where she should be. In a companion's scenes (her states whose every way in is from one of its states: `G.companionScenes`), nor is her HUD: an action her own Explods hold on the screen (`postype = left`, `right`, `front` or `back`, never on a player) that her states never play as a pose and whose frames draw nothing inside the receiver windows (Mai's 22001 is her CvS groove label, `postype = Left` in her Cvs2_system.cns; Brian's Striker put her in his 22001 and she was drawn as "A-GROOVE" under his feet). An explod that can fire only once the round is over (RoundState = 4, MatchOver, Win or Lose in every way its triggers can hold) is no HUD: the gallery's round never ends (Kung Fu Girl's lose picture 22201, `postype = left` on `RoundState = 4` and `Lose && ... && matchover`: in his companion's 22201 she is drawn, so her position 3 phase 3 is listed). Everywhere else her HUD is read as before, an answer like any action of hers: read in every scene, the rule would change pairs of builds no companion is in (a grope stage 6200 on a Makoto whose 6200 is a HUD explod too), which is the owner's call. An explod of window art stays hers either way (Cynthia's 15600, her Kuromaru pose on 19230). A detected giver who is no receiver answers another giver's demands mostly with his own giver art (DongHwan's hub overlay 42249 draws group 4251, an explod of his 6001; Brian's 27230 draws 27230 and his 18200 draws 7251; Minotaur's 36699/36899 draw 6699/6899): one of his own actions counts as her answer only where its frames draw a sprite inside the receiver windows that his .sff has and none of them is H art outside those windows (Kur0maru's 17231-17234 on the Kuromaru-template woman 17230; Brian's 69280-69581 draw his own scene art 16520/16011/16181 beside a window group and are none; an ordinary group of his may lead in: kuromaru_girl_plus's 15600 starts on her win pose 182, then her Kuromaru pose), while the other giver's fallback art on his sprites is judged as for anyone (DongHwan's and Brian's positions on Kur0maru's 19230/12250/17230). His probe answers stay his whole table: the engine asks his actions, whatever they draw. And he is never a receiver when his -2 would act in the scene: -2 runs whoever's state he is in (-3 and -1 only in his own), so a controller there that spawns a helper, changes or gives a state, hits, stops time (Pause, SuperPause), draws (Explod, ChangeAnim), moves him (PosSet, PosAdd, VelSet, VelAdd), binds anyone (TargetBind, BindToTarget) or makes him invisible would run inside her scene, unless its trigger is certainly false (Brian's Striker; DongHwan's SuperPause and three Explods; Kur0maru's -2 only removes an explod, sets a variable and his defense and stops his own sound channel 3). A pair must show something beyond generic reactions (an electrocuted skeleton, a Midnight Bliss).
- **How much of a partial scene she is drawn**: a partial step carries `shown`, the share of the art that gives its verdict whose sprites she has, in ticks over one pass of the action (a blank is time she is not drawn; the least of the step's partial states), and the overlay says it: `[partial 43%]` (Brian's position 4 speed 3 on Kur0maru's template woman draws 17233, 4 of its 6 frames his .sff has). The dwell check cannot see it: she stays in the listed state while undrawn. A step drawn at most half the time whose scene also holds her where she vanishes is the giver posing alone for most of it, and is none (Kur0maru's Jedah on Sakura: 4130 draws his 4138 on sprites she lacks, 4132 his 4130 half the time; Leona, drawn in both, keeps it at 50%).
- **The mirror pair (2026-10-12): a character who is both is his own receiver.** A giver whose role is both - the owner's `hRole: 'both'` (Properties > H role), or the scan's giver AND receiver with no word of his (`hmodule.effectiveRole`) - also gets a pair with himself, P1 and P2 the same character, named as any pair ("Minotaur x Minotaur"); a plain giver, or one marked a giver, gets none (`gallerydata.buildGalleryData`). Why: a giver's victim states draw HIS OWN receiver art only when the one grabbed has it. Minotaur's `ChangeAnim` to her own action where `SelfAnimExist(<n>)`, else `ChangeAnim2` to his (on her sprites), and his files ship 78 such actions (57 in the 36000s, 21 in the 42000s) on 274 sprites in groups 6000-7999 of his own .sff, every one named in his code: art that shows only when a Minotaur is the one grabbed. The pair is judged by the same rules as any other (her verdicts, `sceneJudge`, the walk, `companionHeld`, the stance), with one difference: the GIVER WHO IS NO RECEIVER reading (his own actions count as her answer only where they draw receiver-window groups, and he is never a receiver when his -2 would act in the scene) is for ANOTHER giver's scene. In his own mirror pair the owner's both is the receiver verdict the scan did not reach, and the engine answers `SelfAnimExist` from his whole .air, as for a character the scan reads as both, so that reading is left out there (`answers` and `actsInScene` null for that pair only; his pairs as another giver's receiver keep it). Minotaur's -2 acts, read: two helpers (his gauge 8000 and his drip 8100, each made only when none is out, at round state 2) and three VelAdds only in his own jump start 50 - by their triggers none acts in a scene. P2 takes the next free palette, as the engine's own select screen gives a mirror match (`start.f_selectPal` over what is selected; Minotaur's 2, the same `Act/Normal.act` as his 1); every other pair keeps 1. The runtime tells the two apart by player number only (the giver P(2k-1), the receiver P(2k), `getStateOwnerPlayerNo`, the requests set on the giver's own maps), never by name, file or palette, and his 65 `p2name = "Minotaur"` exit guards run from the victim's side (her p2 is the giver), so they read the same in a mirror pair. The pair bench always took one character on both sides. Main, measured: Minotaur x Minotaur 54 steps, 64 of his 94 scenes tailored, 2 unreachable (Minotaur x Mai: 62 steps, 69, 11, unchanged by it). The scan's both makes one more there: Colette (the scan reads her as giver and as receiver by orphans; no H role set) gets Colette x Colette, 16 steps from the mob prototype mode alone (the core finds none for her). Her H role decides it: giver or receiver takes it away, with her pairs on the other side. Played headless on a scratch bundle (Minotaur alone, marked both): P2 stands in his own 0 before the grab, and the grab (her 1221: his buster, whose 36221 draws group 6221, a Minotaur upside down), press a (1285), standing position 1 (1816, 36816 on 6816) and the horse's position 1 (7216, 42216 on 7216 and 36616 on 6616) each showed, the last two with his female art on P2.
- **Names**: a command reaches the runtime only as its exact latin1 bytes; labels are ASCII inputs the way the .cmd defines them and never repeat the step's group, which names what the step belongs to ("Bao" for the Baomaru hub, else his ASCII move name when unique, else a summon's helper name - told apart by each one's input when several summons share it ("dog hold Back+z", "dog hold Down+z") - else the grab's input - Minotaur's own names are Japanese). A held element is said as a hold, never as a motion step: Kur0maru's `/B,z` (hold Back while pressing z) is "hold Back+z", a longer motion says each hold ("motion hold Down,hold Back,a").
- **Caches** per process, keyed on the path, size and time of every file a character's .def names: the build inside every VFS build costs almost nothing when nothing changed.
- **The pair file: the pairs kept across starts (2026-10-12, §3.1 *Caches*).** The caches above live one process, so every server start paid the whole walk again inside its first build, on the server's one thread, while the page's first read waited (17-19 s on the scratch copy of Main, 25-44 s on Main). `gallery.buildForRoster` asks `buildGalleryData({ persist: true })`; every other caller (tests, tools) is unchanged.
  - **Where:** `<bundle>/backups/gallery-pairs.json` - the `backups/` folder beside the `roster.json` that `layout.js` names, where E-Select's roster copies already go. It is the bundle's machine state: never inside a character folder (in a read-only bundle the characters folder IS the build's `chars/`), writable in a build opened in place, ignored by git in the checkout (`/backups/`). Safe to delete: the next start walks every pair again and writes it anew.
  - **Its key:** line 1 is `{"format":"gallery-pairs 1","version":...}`, the version a hash (`codeVersionOf`) of `gallerydata.js` and every local module its literal `require()`s reach, transitively, plus every `.js` in `gallerymodes/` and `gallerymodes/self-director.js` BY NAME, its bytes or "(absent)" - the self mode loads its director by a path it builds, and deleting the director turns it off, so both an edit and a deletion must change the version. Any code change drops the whole file once. Then one `[key, sig, value]` per line; a line is used only while its `sig` - the in-process cache's own, path:size:mtimeMs of BOTH characters' `.def` and every file their `[Files]` name - still matches. **Left out on purpose:** the roster's roles, the mirror pair and the modes' switches. They decide which pairs are ASKED for (`#mode:<id>` keys, only for modes that are on), not what a pair's answer is; a file outside a character's `[Files]` is never read by the gallery.
  - **What goes in:** only a value whose copy is the same value (plain objects and arrays, finite numbers, strings, booleans, null, Maps and Sets of string or number keys, tagged; no accessors, symbols, holes or loops). Anything else is worked out again every start, as before (the mob mode's pairs carry a function).
  - **Bounded:** the pairs this process's persist builds USED are written, and a pair it did not use stays while the bundle's roster names both its characters (`rosterPairSides`, 2026-10-13: a process whose only build is part of the roster - a command-line public export, a tool - used to write back its part alone, and the next start walked every other pair again). So the file is the roster's size, never what every past roster added: a character taken out of the roster drops out with its pairs (a build of a given list of characters, with no roster to read, keeps only what it used; a mode switched off for one start drops its pairs, walked again once when it comes back). It stops at **64 MB** (UTF-8 bytes); at the cap a file that already holds exactly the kept lines is not rewritten. It is not rewritten when nothing changed.
  - **Written atomically:** `<file>.<pid>.tmp`, then a rename with the roster's retry (5 x 100 ms); the temp is removed with `lifebars.rmFile` when the write fails, and one console warning says so. **A temp file a crash left** (`gallery-pairs.json.<pid>.tmp` whose process is gone) is swept at the next load (`persistSweep`); a live process's temp is left alone.
  - **Recovery:** a missing file, a damaged line, a garbage file, another format or another code version, or a folder that cannot be written: those pairs are walked again, never a failure of the build.
  - **Measured** (the scratch copy of Main, 35 characters): the first gallery build after a start 17.5-19.4 s with the file empty (the same work as before; it writes 4.4 MB), 4.2 s with it full; RSS after it 397-416 MB, was 638-667 MB. The Lua and the ZSS are byte-identical with no file, an empty file and a full one, and after an edit to one character. Test: `tools/test-gallery-persist.js`.

**A step's path runs inside the running scene, by the giver's own commands.** A step is his grab (`entry`) plus a PATH of actions (gallerydata.js's version 2), each finished when her state is one of its `until`. A common state `[StateDef -4]` (`data/hgallery.zss`, [Common] `States7`) makes his commands true with `AssertCommand{name: "<his .cmd name>"}`: one line per command name the build's steps use, numbered, asserted when the driver's map `_gal_c` (the action being held or pressed) or `_gal_c2` (one sustained beside it) holds its number. AssertCommand in -4 sets the command's buffer in every command list he has before his -3/-2/-1 and his state run, so the command is true for his states that same frame (Lua writes at T, true at T+1) with no raw input: no facing, SOCD or hardcoded walk/jump/guard (those read the raw buffer, not command names), no see-through toggle (DongHwan's is a *press* of the current position's direction), no motion firing his direction switches on the way. Asserted every frame it is held; one frame is a press. The names are literals, so the hook is generated per build like the script; written as latin1 bytes they match a Shift-JIS .cmd name byte for byte (a trail byte `}` inside the quotes is fine: the reader skips quoted text), a name with a double quote cannot be written (its steps are dropped), and an empty one would assert a random command of his (never written). -4 because it must run in every state, including her custom ones; `ignorehitpause` on the whole block, or it lapses in his hitpause (ZSS blocks default to ignorehitpause -2). It acts only under `gameMode = "hgallery"` and `!isHelper`, never on a map flag alone: a map value can outlive the mode, a game mode cannot.

- **Variables are set by the hook, never by Lua** (Lua has no var setter): `var(map(_gal_vNi)) := map(_gal_vNv);` or `fvar(...)`, one-shot (the hook clears the request), in place for his whole next frame. A Lua `changeState` made in the same tick is applied next frame after -1, so the jumped-to state starts with the value. A pair's `setup` (Minotaur's pleasure gauge var(56): below 6000 every insertion ends in the groin kick; Brian's Striker gate var(14)) is asked for every frame from the first frame of the match and held by the hook, so his round start and his own decay both see it.
- **Held**: asserted every frame until `until` shows, then released; a hold the data gave no mode that lets go again within 2 s (she is back in a state she was in while it was held) is held for as long as the step is on screen - a named hold never is (a climax held on climaxes again). **Mashed**: pressed every 10 frames for as long as the step is selected (a hub that answers every press). **Sustained**: asserted every frame while the step is selected (DongHwan's `hold_y`/`hold_a`/`hold_b`: the VarSet fires only on the hub's one cycle-end tick, so a press almost never lands, and a speed plays one 6002 cycle per hold). **Pressed**: one frame, again every 20 until it shows. A climax held until it shows is released at once: held on, the next hub cycle climaxes again.
- **A jump** (Lua `changeState`) is made only while his state is the action's `at` (made during a grab intro it reads variables the scene has not set yet), with its sets in the same tick, and again only when he comes *back* to `at` from another state, never on the hub's own re-entries (they would restart the hub before it acts). `stateNo()` changes at the call; the jump shows next frame (`prevStateNo`, `time` 1). A set alone (`{set}`) and a wait (`{until}`) are actions too.
- **Paths are absolute, so a step of the grab already running is reached in place.** An action whose `until` already shows is done at once, and a position command is guarded where it already is (DongHwan's `holdfwd` in position 1), so the step's path runs from wherever the scene is: the grab's own step carries the way back (`holdfwd` until 6201), and position 1, each position's speeds, its own climax (`hold_c` in the hub at position k: her 6200+5k with his 6005) and auto are all reached without the intro. A jump into 6005 is not a climax step: it plays his position-k anim over her base unless a draw fires. A fresh grab happens only for another grab, a scene that ended by itself (Minotaur ends every scene after its climax, so that step is grabbed again and its path re-run), or an action that did not show within its `patience`: counted from her last state change or re-entry, so a climax still playing out is waited for; never more than 3x in all; at least 600 for the first action after a fresh grab, because the intro plays first. Missed in place, a step is tried once from a fresh grab; missed from there, it is said on screen. A scene that ends three times before it shows stops with a note.
- A step that moves on after it showed (a climax back to its position) has its path run again in place after 90 frames, so it stays on screen until the viewer moves on; a grab alone is grabbed again, and so is a leaf (her orgasm). A step that ends in a state it never leaves (its `endStates`) is grabbed again after 90 frames there.
- **A step given up on leaves nothing playing.** begin('stuck') asks his summoned helpers gone (the pair's kill list, as at a reset; his companion is on it) for the whole stuck phase, so one his own lines bring out again goes too; the next reset's place lets them be. On the stuck phase's third frame, where anything still runs (she in his states or dropped by a helper that held her, or either one out of state 0), both are stood up with selfState(0) as a reset does, and his root's leftover explods are cleaned in frames 3-6 (`_gal_clean`). Before, a Monsters demon girl that had not arrived in time walked on and played its whole scene under "this scene did not start", over and over, and Colette's root stayed in her receiver state 1411. Played (2026-10-08): "stuck: his summoned helpers out 4000=0" at 30 and 300 ticks, R.Mika alone under the note.
- **The intro purge takes helpers' pictures**: `destroySelf{removeexplods: 1; removetexts: 1}`, as the engine's own intro skip clears every explod and text of the player (system.go clearPlayerAssets); a helper's explods outlive it otherwise (char.go destroy). Goblin Party's guild hall and desk (removetime -1, screen space) stayed over the stage for the whole session.
- **Where a step is played from.** A step's `place` {front, gap} stands her `front` px from the screen edge he faces and him `gap` px behind her (`rightEdge()-leftEdge()` halved on him: PosSet is camera-relative, and that is the edge a helper's `postype = front` uses): Minotaur's summoned horse walks in from that edge and throws only 26-68 px in front of it, so the default +/-18 leaves her 15 px short. `clear` names the helper a summon calls. **Every reset removes the helpers of the pair's summons** (the union of its steps' `clear`, the pair's `kill` list): the driver sets `_gal_k<id>` on the giver on the reset's first frame, and one hook line per id in the build (`isHelper(<id>) && root, map(_gal_k<id>)`) destroys that helper with its own helpers and explods the next frame, before both stand up on the third. A dog holds her up to 896 ticks, past any wait, and one left out stands in the next scene or grabs her again (a leftover horse blocks the next summon, which spawns only with `NumHelper(7000) = 0`). Destroying a helper that binds her with TargetBind drops her to 5050 (the engine's `destroy`), which the reset's stand-up fixes. The place still holds the grab while such a helper is out, and a reset that a leftover helper undoes (it throws her back into his states) is made again. The log says at every grab how many of his summoned helpers are out. An action's `from` lists his states where its command acts: in place, a command he is elsewhere for grabs again at once instead of pressing a button into another meaning (in an insertion, the foreplay button switches position).
- **A companion's step, played.** The step's own setup is written over the pair's (the same variable replaced, a new one added), and only from the `summon` phase on and only where the step plays: the companion spawns where he stands and facing as he faces (Brian's -2: `pos = -100,0` from p1), so the gate opens after the place - opened during a reset it spawned before the pair was placed, 300 px off and facing away; a step refused between two pairs, or given up on, keeps the pair's gate shut (a released companion roamed into the other pairs), and giving up removes it. After the place the driver waits in `summon` for it to stand in one of its idle states (Lua `helper(id)` inside the giver reads its state), then enters his stance with Lua `changeState` (a state of his, as every grab), and while it waits for her in his scene (`enter`) asks the hook for the companion's grab command: one hook block per companion in the build (`isHelper(<id>) && gameMode = "hgallery"`) asserts it in the companion's own command list on `root, map(_gal_hc)`, and holds the step's pins on it every frame on `root, map(_gal_hp)` (one numbered line per distinct pin set in the build; a helper's own map is a copy made when it spawned, so it reads its root's), and the step's held animation on `root, map(_gal_ha)` (lines per distinct hold, after the position lines; asked for with the pins, from the summon to the show). A companion's step is reached in place only while he still stands in his stance (his threesome leaves it for his 69230: the next step grabs again), and not where the art variant her state reads of his on entry changes while her state stays (the step's `companion.art`, "var(33)=0" / "var(33)=1": position 4 under him to on top at the same speed grabs again; Build A's Gardevoir kept her 51409 art while Bao played 466001). Its states are her custom states owned by his root, so "in the scene" is read as for his own. A position is set by the hook: while the step's path waits (`act`) the driver asks `_gal_hg` = its number, and one hook line per position in the build (in the same block, after the pins) sets the counter and puts the companion in the position's state (`var(2) := 4; selfState{value: 51488}`) while it stands in a state the counter's line names and not yet at home there - in its -4, before its own lines run, so the line's own draw never runs and the state starts with the pins (a move between two positions in place shows her only the two positions' states, two frames; a fresh grab of the rapid family passes one frame of position 3). A player's b still counts on from there. A scene key that lands on the grab's one tick hands the grab the new step (`HGalleryScene` returns early there): a companion's step then goes to `summon` first when its companion is not out and idle (its entrance, 150 frames, came after his stance), and another step resets first when a companion of the pair is out. Every reset removes the companion (its id is on the pair's kill list); the log line of grabs that counts his summoned helpers out leaves it out on its own steps. A player's keys on the active giver do what his readme says: in the stance, a/x/b/y/c/z are his (speeds, position, get off, threesome, leave the stance), and the companion reads the directions itself (Forward/Back walk it or toggle its see-through, Up/Down start its grab).
- **A receiver's helper, played.** Every read of "her" (in the scene, her state and time, the dwell, the log) goes to the helper inside her root: Lua `helper(id)` inside player 2k; her state is -1 while she is not out. The place stands both facing the screen edge she comes from (her root's `postype = front`): him in front, her root 90 behind him (his 4501 lunges forward with velset 10 and Clsn1 5-45 in front, never behind, and hits everything it touches: `hitonce` is 1 for throws only). **Neither may turn** (`AssertSpecial NoAutoTurn` on both from the hook, every frame from the match's first): a MUGEN character with control turns to face P2 on a ChangeState out of a standing state (the engine's changeStateEx), so the driver's own `changeState` into his grab turned him to her root, and his grab took Kira while Chichi stood in front of him. After the place the driver asks the hook for her root's summon command (`_gal_c` on the root, a press every 20 frames until she is out: the hook's AssertCommand comes after the input update that NoInput clears, so her root's -2 spawns her that frame); she runs in from that edge and, once she stands in a ready state, the hook stands her 36 in front of him, facing him (`_gal_rp`/`_gal_rx`/`_gal_rf` on her root, read through `root, map(...)`, once), and he grabs two frames later - about 30 frames after the summon, well inside her taunt. Left her ready states before the grab, or gone before it caught her: the reset and the summon again. Every reset removes her (her kill line reads her root's `_gal_k<id>`): after a scene she is left in her root's own states, the root's body at her scale. **His explods on her are removed in the hook's own `[Statedef +1]`** (where a step's re-rolls run too, on him: `_gal_rr`, the step's set of them by number, one line per re-roll - `stateNo = <at> && prevStateNo = <from>` -> `targetState{value: <her>}`, then `selfState{value: <from>}`, each on a line of its own: a SelfState ends the block, so nothing after it runs, and two controllers on one line after a `;` do not compile) (the file's last section; a common file's negative states, +1 among them, are added after the character's own, so it runs after her state and after her root's bridge): `removeExplod{id: <n>}` for each listed id on `isHelper(<id>)`, every frame. RemoveExplod takes the explod out of the list at once and explods are queued for drawing only after every character has run, so the one made that frame is never drawn - removed from her -4 instead, it would be drawn for one frame. With several pairs her steps play in an edge slot only, both facing that edge (mirrored at the far left). That slot puts him at the slot's center + 45 toward the edge (a normal pair's giver stands at center - 18), so her scene sits 63 units nearer the screen edge than a normal pair's: at two pairs (zoom 0.874) her glove touches the far right edge in position 2's climax, and mirrored at the far left his knee and foot in position 4 are cut by a 4:3 stage's edge. Left as is: moved inward, her root (her Clsn2 60 px behind her at [Size] 0.5, 56 in front) would stand in the next pair's reach - at the far right she stands 90 behind him, her box's back edge 18 px short of the Clsn1 of the neighbor's giver where he stands (at her slot's center - 168; DongHwan's 4501 reaches 5-45 in front of him, `hitonce` 0: it takes all it touches), so 20 units inward already puts it 2 px inside; a smaller RBACK only trades that for less than the 39 px between her box and his own Clsn1. A scene key during the summon hands the coming grab the new step.
- **Both sides are players: P1 is the home team.** `main.f_default` sets the home team to 2 (the arcade CPU's side) and only versus-style modes set it to 1; a CvS-style character reads `IsHomeTeam` on the right at round start as "I am the CPU" and runs her own AI on a variable, whatever `AILevel` says (Yoko's var(59)), throwing a giver whose grab takes a few frames to connect (Brian, Minotaur). The gallery calls `setHomeTeam(1)` for every pair.
- **A reset leaves nothing of his last scene on screen.** `selfState(0)` removes only explods flagged to go on a state change, and a MUGEN scene cut short never runs its own RemoveExplods (Kur0maru has 156 explods with `removetime -1`, bound to him: his buster hand, his chair piled up and covered her). From the reset until a frame before the grab, the hook runs `removeExplod{}` on the giver: his own explods only, never his helpers' (a gauge) or hers; a status explod his -2 keeps up comes back that same frame.
- **MUGEN's hit priority, for a giver written for MUGEN.** MUGEN puts the attacker at sprite priority 1 when his HitDef connects unless it names `p1sprpriority` (or its DOS alias `sprpriority`); Ikemen GO 1.0.0 leaves him where he was (§5.7). A MUGEN scene layers on it: Kur0maru's glory hole 51205 holds him at 2 and her hips at 2, meant to draw over his tentacle mass once his hit drops him to 1 - on Ikemen the tie draws the attacker on top. For a giver with no `ikemenversion` the pair carries `p1spr.keep` (his states whose HitDef names its own priority), and outside those the hook applies the default the frame after `moveHit`, before his state runs, as MUGEN does; his next statedef or SprPriority still wins.
- The commands stop two frames before any reset puts both back in their own standing state, and none is asserted while he stands in a basic state (below 200) with control: a scene that ended while she still lies in it, where a button is an attack. His power is kept at max (motion gates want Power >= 1000). The driver's clocks stop while `paused()` (the Pause key freezes the fighters, not the Lua loop).
- An asserted command does everything a player's input does in that state, so a path never holds what ends or freezes the scene: a release (DongHwan's `z`), a toggle (`s`, a see-through press, continuous mode), a time stop. Auto keeps running into the next step unless that step's action turns it off the way his own inputs do: DongHwan's held y/a/b set `var(37) = 0`, which a position action can set; Brian's intro turns auto on at its very end, so his auto-off has to come after the hub shows.

**A pair's scenes are positions, and the keys move along them.** Every step carries `nav` { pos, speed, ver, climax, stage } (gallerydata.js NAVIGATION): steps with the same `pos` are one position, ordered by first appearance in the pair's list, and a one-off (a grab alone, a summon, a dog) is a position of its own; `speed` is 0 for the position's base (its hold), 1..n for its speeds in the order his own inputs step them, `'auto'` for auto (after the top speed), null on a climax and where the position has no speeds; `ver` the 0-based art version (0 with one look); `climax`; `stage` 0 for the base, 1..n for finish-count stage levels. A step that has `nav` keeps it; `deriveNav` gives it to the rest from what the steps carry, never a giver's name or state numbers:

- a group whose name ends in "position k" is one position (DongHwan's hub, Kur0maru's Bao, Minotaur's ladders, Brian's positions), and so is a group whose labels mark a speed, a phase, a climax or auto; a companion's step is its position by its `go` (its counter's value), its grab alone a one-off; a walk step its NAV ROLE places (below) joins its hub's position where two steps or more rest in that hub; any other step is a one-off;
- speeds come from the labels ("speed k", a ladder's "phase k"), ranked 1..n, the unmarked step being the base (Minotaur's "press x" is the base, his "speed 2" and "speed 3" are 1 and 2); a speed the walker names with no number (", speed": JenetBonne's "hold a, speed", "hold b, speed", "hold y, speed" in Degenerate Mugen) ranks after the numbered ones, in list order - whether that is her own order is unchecked; before, all three sat on her grab's place, 359 steps in 114 pairs no key reached; "auto" and "climax" from the labels too;
- versions are a companion's art pins, in order of first appearance in the position (Bao's var(3): upright 0, bent over 1; var(33): under him 0, on top 1; Gardevoir, on top only, has one look there: 0), and, from NAV ROLES, two bases or two speeds of one rank that rest in one hub, which would otherwise sit on one place no key reaches (Minotaur's horse grab and its four foreplays: versions 0-4 of one position);
- a step without nav whose position the rule shares with a step that has nav takes that step's key (a key the data already gave wins);
- a hub group's key is its name (with the grab's where two grabs of the pair have a group of that name), and versions end 0-based among the looks the pair's position has (a companion's walk numbers them by its variant, and a receiver may have only the second).

**Nav on the steps a build adds, where it makes them**: they are placed by the deriver too, with what gallerydata.js's finishes say of them (`navHint`, `navStage`). Her orgasm is a climax, his climax's other finish, never a version (`ver` is an art look or a hub's second base or speed): where the position has its own climax, that one is finish 1 (`speed` 1) and hers finish 2 (`speed` 2), and Up/Down switch between them at the climax ("his finish Up/Dn" / "her finish Up/Dn" on the line; from any other step Up/Down stay versions and never land on her orgasm); where it has none (the grope stage), hers is still numbered 2, so Left/Right from one orgasm go to the next position's orgasm. A group it is in is one position (the grope stage and her orgasm there are one, "the grab"); a gauge gate's failure is a one-off though its group is a ladder's (Minotaur's "insertion fails (press x)", right after position 1's rungs - read by the group alone, the whole ladder took its key); position 5's steps are a hub position like the others (its speeds 2 and 3 rank 1 and 2; the overlay says the labels' numbers, and Left/Right compare speeds by them). A stage copy is its step's place at its stage: a copy of a companion's step takes its step's nav at once, a copy of any other carries `navStage` and the deriver gives it its step's nav with that stage (a copy comes right after its step, or after the step's other copies).

On the Main roster: DongHwan x R.Mika 4 positions of base, speeds 1-3, climax and auto; Brian x Kira 13 (his grab stage with her orgasm there, his positions 1-7, each with his climax and her orgasm as its two finishes - position 5 its speeds 2 and 3 besides -, the Striker Bao's grab alone and its positions 1-4, positions 2 and 4 in two versions, positions 1 and 2 with two climax pictures; Kung Fu Girl adds the threesome, a position of its own); every Kur0maru summon and dog a one-off, but his Tentacle chair is one position (the grab, and "press a, 6 times" its climax), his Tentacle Maiden one position of phase 1, phase 2 and a climax, and his Sakunyu attack's press a and press x two versions of one position; Minotaur's 12 ladders base, two speeds and a climax each, and his horse grab with its foreplays one position in five versions.

**The giver compatibility pass (2026-10-07): rules that read more givers.** Measured over 120 givers (the Old Classic Aggressors zip and every G:\Game build, deduplicated by their code files), each paired with R.Mika and Kung Fu Girl Z, best of the two: steps 2,130 -> 2,447, real positions (not one-offs) 149 -> 365, positions with speeds 159 -> 354, climaxes 214 -> 305, reached scenes 2,484 -> 2,540, no giver losing a step, a scene, a position or a speed. Each rule is written out in gallerydata.js's header comment; in short:
- **NAV ROLES** (the walk tells the deriver what each switch does, not only its words): a step's position is the HUB his scene comes to rest in (the first state on his way from where the switch sent him that he stays in, has switches or two commands acting there, and does not leave by time); a switch into a state the hub's own command enters that comes back by time is a SPEED, ranked in the hub's controller order (FutaRB's Fuck1 < Fuck2 < Fuck3); any other switch resting there is its BASE; a switch whose scene ends by itself with no hub, after two scenes or one that releases her, is the hub's CLIMAX, and so is a finisher by count; a press ladder of the same command (BUTA's y, y, y) is RUNGS: phases 1..n and, ending the scene, its climax. The FutaRB and FutaCR series went from 32-51 one-off positions with no speeds to 8-13 positions with speeds 1-3.
- **TIMED LADDERS**: a grab (or one switch into it) whose scene runs with no input through his states in one line, each giving her her next scene, is one step per rung, "phase k", its last the climax (arrange_dragon_DHQ_Futa: 3 steps -> 18). A later rung is waited for with `from` its rung states; in place past it, the runtime grabs again at once.
- **ANIM HUBS** (FutaBT, the brand that keeps her in one state and changes only HIS animation, hers his + 1000): one hub state with command ChangeAnims gives positions (a press he stays in), speeds (a press that plays and comes back) and a climax (a ChangeAnim no command reaches because a meter is below its number: the hook sets the meter once at the position's idle); every action names his animation (`anim`, done only when it shows), where it acts from (`fromAnim`), and the step the animations it shows in (`anims`). The grab's own step is gated on the grab's idle too: her state is the same in every position, so reached in place from another position he is grabbed again (the reviewer caught position 2 shown under position 1's label). FutaBT Fairy Phewtith, Sakura, Tifa: 2 steps -> 40 (2 grab tables x 4 positions x base, 3 speeds, climax).
- **Summons**: a helper whose states only spawn the helper that grabs is a summon, 3 deep (`clear` the grabber, `clearAlso` the others, removed at every reset: Ripps' ant hole); a helper-played summon's states are closed over her own chain before judging (Succubus' Bulleta lead-in); in a summon helper's walk `root,command` / `parent,command` read as no input.
- **Gates**: a gauge only his strokes fill, with a no-command ChangeState on `var >= N`, is held at 0 in the setup, and a press through it gets a climax step that sets it (Murakami); a Baomaru hub may carry a third small-domain variable (f.sanae's var(25): her buff climax as a second picture); two grabs read as hubs are "Bao (<grab name>)" and each hub belongs to its own grab; an AnimTime behind a redirect is no trap; un-redirected Win/Lose/MatchOver read 0 (an AI flag set on a win stays 0); `Random` ChangeStates in a row are each followed (Morrigan's three variants); a grab and a summon giving her the same states from different issuers are two steps.
- Detection (§4.3): the fallback door and probe windows (Black.T, Marasama, Roper gained), dangling commands and self-asked probes (kyko, Ryougi Shiki dropped).

The first tier left for later, and where each went in round 2: givers that spawn a mob of givers onto her (§4.10c, mob givers); characters that are galleries of their own (§4.10c: Succubus' hub, ero_helper_gs' director; Rule34's menu and Sanae's quick pick stay out); scenes only after her KO or the match's end (§4.10c, KO scenes); Marasama's six creatures (PRESS SUMMONS below); FutaRB/FutaCR climaxes and auto (CLIMAX BY DRAIN, AUTO BY SET, LONG CYCLE); FutaNT Android 21 (VARIABLE ANIM HUBS); and what the headless runs could not play - dashes, far boxes, air starts, dragon_futa2's AI detector, Taokaka's endless intro, helper-launched grabs (the rest of the fix pass).

**The fix pass (round 2, 2026-10-07): grabs the gallery could not start, and climaxes it could not name.** Each rule is read from the files (gallerydata.js's THE FIX PASS, galreach.js and gallery.js's THE FIX PASS have them in full); every new field is optional, and a step without it plays as before. Over the same 120 givers, prototypes off: steps 2,447 -> 2,623, climaxes 305 -> 409, autos 108 -> 168, real positions 365 -> 370, reached scenes 2,540 -> 2,556, givers with no pair 18 -> 16; 17 rows change (FutaRB x7, FutaCR x3, FutaNT Android 21 1 -> 44 steps, GnollK, both OviRenamons, Minotaur 1_1, ero_helper_gs, Marasama) and none loses a step, a scene or a climax.
- **GRAB REACH** (`galreach.js`; the step's `reach` and `reachMin`, 320-wide units). The pair stands 18 px each side of the center (GAP 36 with several pairs), and some grabs miss from there: FutaRB Mina's dash 35330 (velset 35 on an animation with no Clsn2: he never pushes her and runs through her), Succubus' 21000 (runs at his run speed for ten ticks before its HitDef goes live), Roper's far boxes. The grab's first ticks are replayed in the engine's order (char.go actionRun 12160-12176, posUpdate 9928-9990): the state's controllers (header velset at entry; VelSet, VelAdd, VelMul, PosAdd and ChangeAnim on triggers that read only time - movehit and its kin 0 before the hit, commands 0), then pos += vel, then the physics (S: stand.friction, a speed under 1 px stops; A: gravity, landing ends it). His box is the Clsn1 of the element shown that tick at his [Size] xscale and 320/localcoord (updateClsnScale, char.go 7854-7876), live from the tick his HitDef fires; her body is her standing Clsn2 core (action 0). Push runs before the hit and needs both Clsn2 (char.go 14140), so the connect test pushes her ahead of his front only on frames of his with a Clsn2. A step gets `reach` only where the default stand misses: the least distance that connects with no contact before the hit, plus 24 px (or half the window). Any non-time atom in a velocity, ChangeAnim or HitDef trigger makes the model none (no reach); a Projectile in the first ticks is inert for his motion (Tendril 610's afterimage: reach 27), and a grab whose hit IS a projectile has no HitDef of his, so no live tick and no reach. Played (gallery.js): one pair stands `reach` apart around the camera, at most the view less 20 a side ("place reach N"); with several pairs that far apart at the pair's place, absolute, past 110 only in an edge slot (`wide`, the far left mirrored so the lunge goes toward the edge) and past 150 only with one pair on screen (`alone`: "this scene plays only with one pair on screen"). A reach step learns no lean (its scene ends where she stood). Corpus: Mina x Another Kung Fu Girl Z 83, Succubus x Mai 133, Roper's 230 x Kai 139, Creatures' worm 107; the Main roster gets none.
- **NO BODY AT REST, THE GALLERY'S STANCE** (`restStance`, the pair's `receiver.stance`). A receiver whose standing animation 0 draws nothing or has no Clsn2 cannot be grabbed where the gallery stands her. Murakami Ryona Mob (Noodles' mob giver, which also ships receiver art: 60 Minotaur-family and 7 Kuromaru-family actions, and a "[Minotaur]" block in his -2 that draws his 36795 while HE is in Minotaur's 4020) has a 0 of one blank frame; his crowd is drawn by his helpers CenterMob / CenterMobBG at a fixed spot on screen, and his state 0 asserts NotHitBy `, ST, AT, HT, NT` every frame (the engine's checkHitBySlot: the attack class alone matches, so the empty state-type part does not disable it). His body shows only in his moves and get-hit animations - the owner's play: his ninja girl comes out on a move, and Minotaur takes her by knocking her down or by a command grab. Such a receiver gets a STANCE on her stand get-hit animation (5000, else 5010, 5001, 5011, one with a Clsn2 whose sprites her .sff holds): the hook (data/hgallery.zss) moves her from her own 0 to the gallery's common state 9119901 (type S, movetype I, ctrl 0, still) while the driver asks (`_gal_stand`, the animation, on the receiver every frame), its last frame held with the engine's own idiom (`changeAnim{value: anim; elem: animElemNo(-1)}`, guardbreak.zss); she leaves it for her 0 when not asked. Her moves are no use as a stance: those that show her body are attacks, supers (480, 491: meter, a SuperPause, a ReversalDef) or short. On Main only Murakami gets one (7 pairs), on 5000. **Played** headless (2026-10-07, states by the log): Brian JMAX x Murakami 3/3 scenes (6201, 6202 in place) and the Striker Bao grab; Minotaur x Murakami 3/3 (1045, 1035 in place, 1545 grabbed again after the scene ended); the negative control is the same run before the stance: every scene "did not start", the receiver in 0. Not looked at on screen (the owner's rule for H scenes): what the stance and the scenes show of his art is his to judge.
- **NO CLSN1, NO GRAB.** A HitDef state none of whose animations (its header and its literal ChangeAnims) has a Clsn1 can never hit, so it is no grab (Allosaurus' 22004: 76 elements). An .air with no Clsn1 anywhere tells nothing (a sheet drawn without boxes) and drops nothing.
- **A SUMMON'S REACH and ITS FRONT STAND.** A direct summon whose Helper spawns at postype p1 is replayed from where it spawns, its Clsn1 at HIS scale (ownclsnscale is off): Creatures' worm (pos 100, VelAdd at AnimElem 7/8). A summon placed at the edge (postype front: the edge he faces, pos x outward) whose helper's box, at his xscale, stops short of her back at the default `place.front` stands her nearer the edge: the helper's farthest live reach toward her (its front when it faces him, else its back) plus her back's Clsn2 core, less 8 px, in his units, only where that is nearer than the default and at least 20 (`summonFront`; YarimusiHIVE's mino 304: Clsn1 -117..116 in the .air is -70..70 in the world at xscale 0.6, 6 px short at 95; stood at 80 it grabs on its first tick).
- **AIR START** (the step's `air` { y, vx, vy }, his own units). A grab state with physics A falls into 52 the tick after a standing `changeState` (char.go 12171-12176). Its steps carry where his lead state's arc meets its ChangeState into the grab (a state whose exit reads vel y or pos y, entered by his press: FutamaruPlus 1800 -> 1801, { -14.4, 2, 9.8 }), else his jump's apex from [Velocity] jump.neu and [Movement] yaccel. On the grab's frame the driver asks for it and the -4 hook, after the place block, sets his position and velocity before the state's first tick, over its header velset; the lift block is in the hook only in a build with an air step. (ZSS: two controllers may share a line inside a block, never with a `;` between them: compiler.go stateBlock.)
- **COMMAND ALIASES** (the pair's `cmdAlias`). The engine's AssertCommand makes true only the command it names (input.go CommandList.Assert). Commands one key makes true together (the same definition, whitespace removed, case kept) are aliases: the walk reads a command as on when an alias is asserted, an alias of a listed switch is the same switch, trimData numbers a name WITH its aliases (`cmdAliases` beside `commands`), and the hook asserts every name of the number on one line (`if map(_gal_c) = n || map(_gal_c2) = n { assertCommand{name: "holdfwd"} assertCommand{name: "holdfwd2"} }`), as a player's key does. dragon_futa2's AI detector `holdfwd ^^ holdfwd2` then stays false, as for a player. Her root's summon command never takes his aliases; a companion's line names the primary only. On Main, 49 of the 59 pairs carry one (Brian's manguri8 = up; DongHwan's hold_b = /b; Kur0maru's FF = fwd, x = 41236x, and more), and the hook built from Main's data has 13 such lines.
- **PRESS SUMMONS.** A Helper of his [Statedef -1] (-2, -3) on one button with control, never with no input, whose button nothing else of his negative or basic states reads, is a step that presses that button while he stands (`noGrab`, `withCtrl`), keyed by the helper's first state; it is not pressed again while the helper it calls (`clear`) is out. Two press summons whose helpers give her the scene from different states are two creatures (Marasama: six steps, x, b, c, a, y, z). A press that brings a whole mob (more than one helper before the grabber: TOBF) is the mob prototype's.
- **SIGNALED GRABS.** A grab only his negative states enter, on a variable whose only nonzero writer is a ParentVarSet in a helper's states, is entered through the state of his that spawns that helper; the step clears that helper, stands her 40 px from the edge it spawns at (postype front) unless it has an APPROACH (below), and is named by it (Monsters' FlowerGirl: 1000, then his -2 into 6000 when it signals var(11) = 1; never the bare 6000).
- **CLIMAX BY DRAIN.** A ChangeState with no command that a player's walk can fire on `V <= N` into a state that issues a scene, in a state that drains V itself (a VarAdd whose every value is negative), with every other write a literal VarSet above N or a positive add that only her command or her AI fires: V is held at the grab's own value (FutaRB var(41) = 75, not the cum's refill 70), and each hub position gets one climax step, its first speed sustained and V held at N from there on, "hold a, gauge empty". A one-time flag nothing drains (Brian's fvar(3)) is none, and so is a positive add on HIS own command. The drain's ChangeState is read where `V <= N` is a trigger line of its own (FutaRB's triggerall), not inside an `&&` line.
- **AUTO BY SET.** A toggle (`V = ifelse(V = 0, 1, 0)` on a command) that a speed's way back to its hub reads (FutaRB's AutoRape var(42): back only on `! Var(42) = 1`) gives one auto step per position, the speed sustained with V held at 1, "hold a, looping" - never "auto" in a label (a label the nav reads makes the whole grab one labeled position; the role says auto) and never the toggle pressed.
- **LONG CYCLE IS A FINISH.** A speed whose state holds him longer than SUSTAIN_MAX (150 ticks) and gives her a scene of its own is its hub's climax (GnollK's ejaculate, 434 ticks; FutaCR's FuckCum).
- **SPEED FROM.** A walk speed's press acts only in its hub and the hub's own speed states (`from`; a base and a finish get none); made in place from another position, it grabs again (FutaRB White-Len from his 51004: "cannot act from his 71003").
- **RUNG 0'S WAIT and A PRESS AFTER A TIMED HANDOFF.** A timed ladder's first rung waits as long as his way to it holds (one shortest way, patience 2 x that + 120: Murakami's 2900 waits 6346). A press that acts only in states his scene reaches by time after more than 300 ticks waits for them: `from` those states, patience the way's ticks + 300 (Yarimusi's 25400 -> 4862 at time 960, patience 1260). A later rung's patience comes from its own rung wait, not rung 0's.
- **VARIABLE ANIM HUBS.** A state of the grab's scene whose ChangeAnim value reads variables his commands VarSet there (FutaNT Android 21's `70000 + fvar(32) + fvar(31)`, + 10000 at fvar(34) = 1) is read by axis: a value picked by the command pressed is the POSITION, a value stepping itself the SPEED, a 0/1 toggle a VERSION (in the step's setup), and a literal set of the speed outside its steps on a command the CLIMAX (its meter, a `> N` its trigger asks, held at the cap his negative states fill it to; its animations the cum sequence his own lines give the speed variable after it). Every step SETs the variables once and is done when his animation shows; only animations his .air has. A version his .air has no table for is dropped, not the hub (its toggle read at 0); a version's climax drawn with an animation an earlier version already gave at that position is that climax, not a second step; a hub that makes no step leaves the walk's own steps. FutaNT Android 21: 4 positions x speeds 1-5 x 2 versions and a climax per position, 44 steps.
- **THE HELD INTRO** (`DATA.introMax` 600). In round state 0-1, before the fight first starts and once per match, an intro still running 600 ticks in is skipped the way a player's button skips it (the engine's runIntroSkip: the hook's cut and purge, held until round state 2): FutaRB Taokaka's 256, a helper that asserts the intro flag every frame and goes only for an AI, never ended it. "intro held past 600 ticks: skipped" in the log.
- **A SIGNALED GRAB'S APPROACH** (the step's `approach` { id, state, dist }). A state on the helper's way that goes on toward its signal only on `P2BodyDist X <= N` (or `< N`, or their abs) into a state the signal's writer is reached from: Monsters' 1100/2100/3100/4100 at 10. Such a step has no place (it plays centered). The hook stands the helper at N - 2 of body distance from her (posAdd `p2BodyDist x - (N - 2)`, her in front) in its walking state while the driver waits for her scene (`_gal_appr`, 'enter' only); its own line then takes it on at once. Why: the walk is VelAdd .17 under physics S, and Ikemen's friction cut (char.go, ST_S: a speed under one pixel a tick is 0) keeps it at .17 px a tick, about 30 s across the screen; the bee and demon never arrived within ENTER_MAX, every retry respawned them at the edge (the "restarting travel" the owner saw), and the flower/slime place stood the scene against the right edge. That WinMUGEN moves them faster is a HYPOTHESIS. Several pairs: the helper's P2 is the nearest receiver, so where the driver reads another pair's it first stands the helper beside her (`_gal_apj`, `_gal_apx` = her x +- 40 on the side it came from). Played: all four creatures on R.Mika, their scenes within about 30 ticks; the flower, bee and demon centered, the slime about 60 units right of center (it arrives on her far side and its scene binds her to it); two Monsters pairs side by side, each creature on its own receiver.
- **A CUTSCENE INTRO** (`cutsceneIntro`, the pair's `cutscene` { helper, state, ends }): a Helper his negative states spawn only in round state 0-1, whose state asserts Intro and whose every exit is bounded only by its own time, past 600 ticks (Goblin Party's ADVENTURE GUILD, helper 33517, state 54119, gone at 3600 or 4250), is cut on the first frame of round state 1 with the same cut and purge as THE HELD INTRO. An exit on a command or a variable alone is no cutscene (the held intro keeps that one). Over about 470 characters (cache/, the OCA zip, Degenerate Mugen, MUGEN-HYPER-EDITION) only Goblin Party has one. Played: "cutscene intro ... cut at match frame 30", round state 2 at frame 34 (605 before), no guild hall. Giver only: a receiver with such an intro would still wait 600 (none found).
- **MURAKAMI'S ROUND (2026-10-08): his scenes played on.** Murakami Ryona Mob (Noodles) as a giver. Each H move is a grab attempt (damage 0, NotHitBy NT) whose hit takes him to his HOLD (p1stateno): the hold gives her the pose at Time 0 and goes into a stroke on any of a, b, c, x, y; a stroke adds to his gauge var(25) and comes back; at 12000 the hold climaxes by itself; with no button for 60 ticks (`Time > 60`) he lets her go. His -1 checks "c" before every c motion but down_c (so F+c and the rest give 484, "grab c") and "down_b" (~D,b) before b and BD_b (so QCB+b gives 487, his WINGED DEMON - his own body in 3600/3601, not a helper; his Hot Limit Bomber 430 is never reached by a player). His manual's High moves (anim 420: 417, 419-425, 484) hit above a standing partner's head: anti-air grabs, landed after his launcher 240.
  - **THE SET OUTLASTS THE HOLD** (hook). A variable the pair's setup holds, which an action SETS on this frame, is not held again in the hook's -1 on that frame: the -4 set marks its slot (`_gal_w<k>`), the -1 setup lines skip a variable a mark names, then clear the marks. Since the -1 block (2026-10-07) every set of a held variable was undone before his state read it: his gauge climax sets var(25) = 12000, and every "gauge full" step ended before it showed. (A mark, not a request left for -1 to clear: a ChangeState in his own -1 ends the -1, and the common file's lines are appended to his.)
  - **ITS STROKES GO ON** (A GAUGE CLIMAX). A gauge climax's stroke is sustained ("hold a") while the step is on screen, so the stroke keeps coming round (pressed once, his hold let her go 60 ticks later: 45-61% on screen; now 100%). A press in a hold with no gauge climax stays a press. The gauge climax waits for the longest animation on its way plus 120 where that passes 600 (his 2002 576 ticks, her 2005 628: patience 748).
  - **THE HEIGHT and AN ANTI-AIR GRAB** (galreach boxAt, liftOf; the step's `lift` { y, anim }). The reach model counts a live box only through Clsn1 rectangles that reach her body's height (as high and as low as any frame of her standing 0 goes, at her yscale). A grab none of whose live boxes reaches that height, whose HitDef hits the air (hitflag A), takes her only in the air: `lift` holds her there - her neutral jump 41 where its frames draw and one has a Clsn2, else her 0 - centered on his first live box's lowest rectangle, with a `reach` where the default stand misses her. The hook holds her in its own common state LIFT_STATE (9119902: type A, physics N, still, out of control) from the place until his grab takes her (`_gal_lift` / `_gal_lifta`). Murakami's 420 boxes sit at -143..-111 (yscale 0.5) against R.Mika's highest frame -93; lifts on her 41: R.Mika -51.25, Kung Fu Girl Z -50.75, Mai -60.75, Yoko -66.3.
  - **A SCENE IN THE AIR** (galreach highOf; the step's `high`). A grab whose hit takes her off the ground into a state of his with physics N gets `high` (how high his feet go); with one pair on screen the view zooms out to 200 / (170 - high) (at least 0.5) while that step is grabbed and shown (camView, the hook's `_gal_vz` on P1: modifyStageVar zoomout/zoomin only), and the stage's own zoom comes back for any other step. Murakami's demon (487 on Mai) rises to -149: zoom 0.627. The zoom is per receiver: Mai, R.Mika, Yoko -149, Kula -160; Kung Fu Girl Z none (he takes her at +4 and rises to -76, in view at the stage's zoom). (Round 2 said the demon "plays on Mai": by her state only - the demon showed, Mai did not; see HIS PROBE PICKS HIS ART.)
  - **HIS PROBE PICKS HIS ART** (gallerydata hisProbes / probePicks). A `SelfAnimExist(N)` that only his ChangeAnim2 lines read, one line each way, picks which of HIS actions she plays. Where the line that fires for her draws none of her sprites (BLIND), her N is no answer of hers: Murakami's demon 3605/3607 ask 17850 and play his 17850 action, which draws sprite group 17850 - Mai ships an action 17850 (her own 9005 pose) but no sprite 17850, so she drew nothing, on any engine, while the reader called it "[tailored]" (her own 17850 frames all present) and round 2 checked her state number. Where it draws her, the old reading stands (Roper 825/827 on her 9005); a one-way probe (Brian's 6200) is unchanged.

Mai in the demon now plays his 3606 then 3608 on her 9005: upright, then upside down, in front of the demon (her sprpriority 0 over his -1 - the layering was never the cause; the gallery's _gal_p1 lifts him only on the hit frame).
  - **HER POSE SPRITES** (herPoseGroups): a sprite group from 6000 to 9999 that one of her H-window actions draws and none of her actions 0-5999 draws is pose art, not get-hit art (her get-hit groups stay ordinary even where an H action reuses one, Mai's 5040). So his fallbacks on her 9005 are listed where her sprites draw them: the demon on Kung Fu Girl Z ("[renders]": cowgirl, then upside down, as the owner played it in training), R.Mika, Yoko, Kula; Brian's position 7 (his 47230-47234) on five receivers.
  - Main, measured: 299 of 322 pairs identical; Brian +47 (position 7), Murakami +29 (405, 415, 418, 484 phase 2, the demon) and -47 (his compat holds whose art is his 26626/21xxx sprites she lacks: BLIND, nothing of her drawn - round 2's own shots of R.Mika's scenes 2 and 3 show him alone), Monsters -3 and Roper -2 (picks that draw groups she lacks), Gnoll Raid 2 a swap only. Played (pixels): the demon on Mai, Kung Fu Girl Z and R.Mika, her body in front throughout; Brian's position 7 on R.Mika; regressions Murakami scene 1 on Mai and R.Mika, Minotaur x Mai.
